context: Cloudflare Turnstile siteverify returns success:false with error-codes on failure; documented codes at https://developers.cloudflare.com/turnstile/. The applying project needs a stable refusal shape that never leaks the sitekey or the secret.
decision: Refuse-if-token-missing status is 400. Refusal body carries a stable error-code (turnstile.token-missing for the guard branch, or the Cloudflare error-codes first entry for the siteverify-failure branch). Refusal body never carries the sitekey, the secret or the response token value. Standards trace clause: Cloudflare Turnstile documented error codes.
consequences: The 400 status is machine-observable at every applied surface; downstream observability records the outcome by error-code, not by sitekey. Event records ship sitekeyHash, outcome and timestamp only (event-secrecy probe asserts this).
title: Refuse-if-token-missing status is 400 with an error-code body (no sitekey leak); siteverify failure carries the documented error-codes value
